name: chair leg
description: Snapped off at the joint, splintered where it broke. Quiet, light, and it will not last the week — which is exactly why it is the first thing most people pick up.
notes: T81 · the commonest row in the table and the worst. Barely better than a fist (the same 1-2), a touch quieter, and 25 durability at 4 a swing = six blows. The floor of the progression axis: something, not nothing.
